title: Budget-Friendly Marketing for Fitness Studios | ClubRight

facts.fact: The article was published in February 2024.
ClubRight's article states that if only half of a studio's members each refer one friend, the membership base would have doubled.
facts.quote: Even if only half of your members refer one friend, you'll still have doubled your membership base.

facts.fact: ClubRight's author bio says the writing team is behind more than 1,000 UK clubs.
facts.quote: Ex-gym owners and the people behind 1,000+ UK clubs
